description:
phi_tuple (types/emptiness.rs) cuts coordinate i by the negation and recurses on the split product. When the cut is empty the callee's first act is to find the empty coordinate and answer 'empty'; the split vector and the step are spent only to learn what the caller can read from the cut it just built.

Change: an empty cut is answered where it is made; no split is built and no step is taken. Spike on the fz-y11.38 tip: every types test passes and the pinned tuple_emptiness_steps count falls from 17 to 7.

Signal: full gate green; the pin is lowered to 7 and listed; no other pin or golden moves; program output and canonical backend dump identical on the probe; allocation count before and after in the commit.
title: A cut that leaves nothing is answered without a recursive step
